description: This is a 3D model of a white window with a grid of panes and a white windowsill. Two curtains, made of a light-colored fabric with a repeating pattern of green leaves, hang from a dark brown curtain rod. The curtains are slightly gathered and extend down to the windowsill. The window is designed in a classic style, suitable for various interior settings. The lighting suggests a soft, natural illumination, casting subtle shadows. The overall impression is one of simplicity and a touch of nature brought indoors through the leaf pattern.
